Of course! Here is a comprehensive list of office furniture brand websites, categorized to help you find exactly what you're looking for, from high-end ergonomic designs to budget-friendly solutions for home offices.

### The Industry Giants (Contract Furniture)
These are the leading brands known for extensive research, high-quality ergonomics, and comprehensive office solutions. They typically sell through authorized dealers but also have direct-to-consumer online stores.

*   **MillerKnoll:** [**millernoll.com**](https://www.millernoll.com/)
    *   This is the parent company of Herman Miller and Knoll. The site serves as a portal to their collective brands.
*   **Herman Miller:** [**hermanmiller.com**](https://www.hermanmiller.com/)
    *   **Known For:** Iconic, design-forward ergonomic chairs like the **Aeron**, **Embody**, and **Sayl**. They offer high-end, research-backed furniture for the entire office.
*   **Knoll:** [**knoll.com**](https://www.knoll.com/)
    *   **Known For:** Classic, mid-century modern designs and sophisticated office systems. Famous for pieces by designers like Florence Knoll and Eero Saarinen.
*   **Steelcase:** [**steelcase.com**](https://www.steelcase.com/)
    *   **Known For:** A direct competitor to Herman Miller, known for its durable, research-driven ergonomic chairs like the **Leap**, **Gesture**, and **Amia**.
*   **Haworth:** [**haworth.com**](https://www.haworth.com/)
    *   **Known For:** Global presence with a focus on "organic workspaces" and adaptable furniture solutions. Their popular chairs include the **Fern** and **Zody**.

### Ergonomic & Standing Desk Specialists
These brands focus specifically on ergonomics, health, and wellness in the workplace, with a strong emphasis on sit-stand desks and accessories.

*   **UPLIFT Desk:** [**upliftdesk.com**](https://www.upliftdesk.com/)
    *   **Known For:** Highly customizable and highly-rated standing desks sold directly to consumers. They offer a huge ecosystem of accessories.
*   **Vari:** [**vari.com**](https://www.vari.com/)
    *   **Known For:** Originally famous for their desktop converters (VariDesk), they now offer a full range of flexible office furniture, including electric standing desks and modular walls.
*   **Humanscale:** [**humanscale.com**](https://www.humanscale.com/)
    *   **Known For:** Minimalism and performance ergonomics. Their **Freedom**, **Diffrient World**, and **Liberty** chairs are praised for their automatic, weight-sensitive recline. They also make excellent monitor arms.

### Direct-to-Consumer & Home Office Favorites
These brands have grown rapidly with the rise of remote work. They focus on stylish, affordable furniture that is easy to buy online and assemble at home.

*   **Branch:** [**branchfurniture.com**](https://www.branchfurniture.com/)
    *   **Known For:** High-quality, affordable ergonomic furniture designed for home offices and startups. Their Ergonomic Chair and Standing Desk are very popular.
*   **Poppin:** [**poppin.com**](https://www.poppin.com/)
    *   **Known For:** Bright, colorful, and modern office furniture and accessories. A great choice for creating a vibrant and energetic workspace.
*   **Autonomous:** [**autonomous.ai**](https://www.autonomous.ai/)
    *   **Known For:** Affordable smart-desks and ergonomic chairs aimed at the tech and gaming communities.
*   **Article:** [**article.com**](https://www.article.com/c/office)
    *   **Known For:** Stylish, mid-century modern furniture. While not exclusively an office brand, their desks, chairs, and shelving are very popular for design-conscious home offices.
*   **Burrow:** [**burrow.com/office-furniture**](https://burrow.com/office-furniture)
    *   **Known For:** Modular furniture that is easy to move and assemble. They offer a range of desks, shelving, and office seating with a clean, modern aesthetic.

### Modern & Design-Forward Brands
These brands are for those who prioritize aesthetics and a distinct, contemporary look.

*   **Vitra:** [**vitra.com**](https://www.vitra.com/en-us/office)
    *   **Known For:** A Swiss company that produces furniture from legendary designers like Charles & Ray Eames, George Nelson, and Jean Prouvé for the European market. Known for impeccable quality and design.
*   **Muuto:** [**muuto.com**](https://www.muuto.com/professional/workspaces)
    *   **Known For:** New Nordic design. Their furniture is characterized by clean lines, soft colors, and a minimalist aesthetic.
*   **Hay:** [**us.hay.com**](https://us.hay.com/office)
    *   **Known For:** Danish contemporary design that is both functional and beautiful. They offer everything from chairs to lighting and accessories.
*   **Design Within Reach (DWR):** [**dwr.com**](https://www.dwr.com/office)
    *   **Known For:** A high-end *retailer* (not a brand itself) that is an official seller for Herman Miller, Knoll, Hay, and many other premium design brands. A great one-stop-shop for authentic designer pieces.

### Mid-Market & Budget-Friendly (Reliable Workhorses)
These brands offer durable, functional, and cost-effective furniture often found in traditional offices, schools, and government buildings.

*   **The HON Company:** [**hon.com**](https://www.hon.com/)
    *   **Known For:** Durable, practical, and no-frills office furniture. A workhorse brand known for its steel filing cabinets, desks, and reliable task chairs like the **Ignition 2.0**.
*   **Global Furniture Group:** [**globalfurnituregroup.com**](https://globalfurnituregroup.com/)
    *   **Known For:** A very broad range of workplace, education, and healthcare furniture solutions, from seating to desking and storage.
*   **Bush Furniture:** [**bushfurniture.com**](https://www.bushfurniture.com/)
    *   **Known For:** Ready-to-assemble (RTA) furniture sold through major retailers. They offer decent quality for the price, especially for home offices and small businesses.
